englishDefinition: Of such high value or cost that ordinary things are not compared with it.

englishDefinition: Exact and accurate, with every detail clearly stated.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سابقی، کسی که پیش از این سمت را داشته است

persianMeaning: گرایش و آمادگی طبیعی برای واکنشی خاص

englishDefinition: More numerous, more common or more influential than other things in a group.

englishDefinition: A short written note at the beginning of a book, written by its author.

englishDefinition: To make someone or something ready for what comes next.

persianMeaning: حرف اضافه، واژه‌ای که پیش از اسم می‌آید
englishDefinition: A word such as in, on or at that comes before a noun to show time, place or direction.

persianMeaning: تجویز کردن، دستور دادن، الزام کردن
englishDefinition: To state officially what should be done in a particular situation.

persianMeaning: حضور داشتن، شرکت کردن در رویداد
englishDefinition: To attend an event or to be there when it happens.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Respected and admired because of its quality, status or position.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Used to say that something is probably true although it is not certain.

examplePersian: نامه بازگشت، بنابراین احتمالاً هیچ‌کس در خانه نبود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

example: Tourists come all summer to look at the mountain scenery.
examplePersian: گردشگران تمام تابستان می‌آیند تا مناظر کوهستانی را ببینند.

persianMeaning: رایحه خوش و بویی که چیزی بر جای می‌گذارد
englishDefinition: A pleasant smell, or the smell that something leaves behind it as it moves.
example: The scent of cut grass spread across the whole field.
examplePersian: رایحه چمن تازه چیده‌شده در سراسر مزرعه پیچید.

englishDefinition: Unwilling to believe something until you have seen good evidence that it is true.
example: Most doctors remained sceptical about the claim of the supplement.
examplePersian: بیشتر پزشکان نسبت به ادعای این مکمل تردید داشتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: برنامه زمانی، جدول و فهرست زمان‌بندی
englishDefinition: A plan that lists the times at which things are going to happen.
example: The new school schedule is published at the end of August.
examplePersian: برنامه زمانی تازه مدرسه در پایان اوت منتشر می‌شود.

persianMeaning: طرح جامع و برنامه‌ریزی‌شده برای رسیدن به نتیجه
englishDefinition: A carefully planned set of actions that is meant to achieve a particular result.
example: The council approved a scheme to build two thousand homes.
examplePersian: شورا طرح ساخت دو هزار خانه را تصویب کرد.

persianMeaning: کمک هزینه تحصیلی، بورسیه و شهریه‌پرداخت
englishDefinition: Money that is given to a student to pay for study at a college or university.
example: She won a full scholarship to study engineering abroad.
examplePersian: او بورسیه کامل برای تحصیل مهندسی در خارج از کشور برنده شد.

englishDefinition: A place where children or students go to learn from teachers.
example: The village school closed because only six children were left.
examplePersian: مدرسه روستا بسته شد چون تنها شش کودک باقی مانده بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: علم، دانش و شاخه‌ای از دانش
englishDefinition: A particular branch of knowledge that studies the natural world through evidence and experiment.
example: Chemistry is the science of how substances react.
examplePersian: شیمی علم واکنش مواد با یکدیگر است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: علمی، مبتنی بر شواهد و روش‌های آزمایشی
englishDefinition: Based on careful testing and evidence rather than on opinion or guesswork.
example: The claim has not been tested by any scientific study.
examplePersian: این ادعا هنوز در هیچ مطالعه علمی آزموده نشده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The people who study the natural world and publish what they find out.
example: Scientists warned that the ice would melt much earlier than expected.
examplePersian: دانشمندان هشدار دادند که یخ بسیار زودتر از انتظار ذوب خواهد شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: قیچی، ابزار برش با دو تیغه
englishDefinition: The tool with two sharp blades joined at the middle, used for cutting paper or cloth.
example: A pair of scissors is kept in every office drawer.
examplePersian: یک دسته قیچی در کشوی هر اداره نگهداری می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To speak to someone angrily because you are annoyed with what they have done.
example: The manager scolded the assistant in front of the whole team.
examplePersian: مدیر دستیار را جلوی کل تیم سرزنش کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: خبر انحصاری و خبر افشاگرانه پیش از دیگران
englishDefinition: A news report about something that is revealed before anyone else has heard it.
example: The first scoop of the election came from a local newspaper.
examplePersian: نخستین خبر انحصاری انتخابات از یک روزنامه محلی رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سوختن سطحی، خشک کردن تا ترک بخورد و گرمازدگی
englishDefinition: To burn the surface of something lightly, or to dry it so hard that it cracks.
example: A hot dry wind scorched the young shoots in the field.
examplePersian: باد گرم و خشک نهال‌های جوان مزرعه را سوزاند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The number of points that a team or a person achieves in a game or an exam.
example: The team scored twice in the second half of the match.
examplePersian: تیم در نیمه دوم بازی دو بار گل زد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A strong feeling of dislike and disrespect for a person or thing.
example: He spoke of the proposal with open scorn.
examplePersian: او درباره آن پیشنهاد با تحقیر آشکار سخن گفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The country in the north of Great Britain, whose capital city is Edinburgh.
example: Scotland has its own education system and legal courts.
examplePersian: اسکاتلند نظام آموزشی و دادگاه‌های مخصوص خود را دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A man who comes from Scotland.
example: A Scotsman farm in the valley is rented out every summer.
examplePersian: یک مزرعه اسکاتلندی در دره هر تابستان به اجاره واگذار می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person sent out to watch a place and to report what is happening there.
example: A scout watched the road for signs of any army movement.
examplePersian: دیده‌بانی جاده را برای نشانه‌های حرکت ارتش زیر نظر داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تکه باقیمانده، باقی و خرده‌های ماده
englishDefinition: A small piece of a thing that is left over after the rest has been used.
example: She wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
examplePersian: او نشانی را روی تکه‌ای کاغذ نوشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خراشیدن، ساییدن و کشیدن با فشار
englishDefinition: To rub a sharp or rough object against a surface so that a harsh sound is made.
example: He scraped the last of the paint from the old frame.
examplePersian: او آخرین لایه رنگ را از قاب قدیمی خراشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خراش، خراش سطحی و شیار کم‌عمق
englishDefinition: A shallow mark or cut that is left on a surface by something sharp.
example: The polish removed years of scratches from the table.
examplePersian: پولیش خراش‌های چند ساله میز را از بین برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A small metal object with a thread, turned to fasten two things together.
example: One loose screw caused the whole shelf to wobble.
examplePersian: یک پیچ شل باعث لرزش کل قفسه شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: متن نمایش، فیلم یا برنامه پخش
englishDefinition: The written words of a play, film or broadcast that the actors speak.
example: The script was rewritten twice before filming began.
examplePersian: متن نمایش پیش از شروع فیلم‌برداری دو بار بازنویسی شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: فهرست طولانی، طومار و صفحه پیمایشی
englishDefinition: A long list of items, especially a page of information that you move down to see more.
example: You have to scroll down a long scroll to reach the sign-up form.
examplePersian: برای رسیدن به فرم ثبت‌نام باید فهرست طولانی را پایین بگردانید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: باوجدان، دقیق و وسواسی در کار
englishDefinition: Very careful about doing what is right, and honest about small matters.
example: The auditor was scrupulous about every line of the accounts.
examplePersian: حسابرسی در هر سطر حساب‌ها بسیار باوجدان بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0
